subject: general
question: Which of the following is related to the reduction of global environmental problems?
solution:
The correct option is __**UNCED.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of **UNCED** is **United Nations Conference on Environment and Development**.
 
• It is also known as the** Rio Summit, the Rio Conference or the Earth Summit**.
 
• This was a major United Nations conference held in **Rio de Janeiro** from** June 3 to June 14, 1992**.
 
• The main issue addressed in this summit was **Climate change.**
 
• The Earth Summit resulted in the following documents:
 
 
• **Rio Declaration on Environment and Development**
 
• **Agenda 21**
 
• **Forest Principles**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNICEF**

 
 
• It ​is an agency of the United Nations responsible for providing humanitarian and developmental aid to children worldwide.
 
• Its full form is **United Nations International Children's Emergency Fund**.
 
• It was founded on **11 December 1946**. Its headquater is **New York, USA**.
 
 
 
• **UNCTAD**
 
 
• ​Its full form is **United Nations Conference on Trade and Development.**
 
• It was established in **1964 **as an intergovernmental organization intended to promote the interests of developing states in world trade.
 
• Its headquarter is in** Geneva, Switzerland.**
 
 
 
• **UNESCO**
 
 
• ​Its full form is **United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization**.
 
• Its United Nations' aimed at promoting world peace and security through international cooperation in education, arts, sciences and culture.
 
• Its headquarter is in **Paris, France**.
 
 

ca:T
